title: Advanced Research for Cancer and HIV (ARCH): Observing Immunotherapies in non-AIDS, nonhepatic (NANH) cancer for HIV Cure
summary: Die ARCH-Kohorte untersucht, ob Immuntherapien im Rahmen von Krebsbehandlungen zusätzlich dazu beitragen können, die versteckten HI-Viren im Körper zu verringern. Dabei wird erforscht, wie sich diese Therapien auf das Immunsystem auswirken und ob sie das HIV-Reservoir verkleinern können. Langfristig soll so besser verstanden werden, ob diese Behandlungen einen Beitrag dazu leisten können, HIV auch ohne dauerhafte Medikamente unter Kontrolle zu halten.

interventions.name: The study involves the prospective observation of HIV-positive patients with solid tumors or hematologic malignancies who are receiving immunotherapy (e.g., checkpoint inhibitors, bispecific antibodies, CAR-T cell therapies). criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
- Confirmed HIV infection under stable ART
- Confirmed cancer (solid tumors or hematologic malignancies)
- Planned immunotherapy as part of standard of care
- Clinically stable general condition
- Adequate organ function according to routine parameters
- Capacity to give informed consent and written consent
- Women of childbearing age using reliable contraception
- Participation of non-German-speaking individuals with confirmed informed consent (interpreters)
Exclusion criteria:
- Severe or unstable comorbidities
- Participation in another clinical trial involving experimental immunotherapeutic or antiviral treatments
- Any other medical, psychological, or social condition that, in the investigator’s judgment, could compromise safety or participation
